test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **Which of the following statements is NOT true according to the passage?**

options.text: The government of Norway allowed bars, restaurants, salons, gyms and schools to stay open.
In the beginning, Sweden’s death rate was similar to other European nations who had locked down.
The mortality rate in Sweden is twice the mortality rate of the United States.
According to scientific estimate, herd immunity for the corona virus is reached when 70-90% of the population becomes immune to the virus.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The government of Norway allowed bars, restaurants, salons, gyms and schools to stay open.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is said in the** first sentence of the first paragraph** of the given passage that *"Sweden, unlike its Nordic neighbours__, made the decision early in the pandemic to forgo lockdown in the hopes of developing widespread coronavirus immunity. The government permitted bars, restaurants, salons, gyms, and schools to remain open while social distancing was encouraged."*
 
• That means, **The government of Sweden allowed all of them not the government of Norway.**
 
• Therefore, the **statement is not true**.

Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**
